parameters.content:
# ShiftHub — Reply YES by Email

Watches the facility inbox over IMAP. A reply of YES (or ok / confirm) from a staff member confirms their next pending shift and sends a confirmation reply.

Needs an IMAP credential (Gmail app password works): host imap.gmail.com, port 993.

nodes.name: Inbox Trigger
nodes.notes: Polls the inbox for new mail (unseen messages).

nodes.name: Match YES Replies
nodes.notes: Only items that match a pending shift continue; everything else is dropped.

nodes.name: Mark Shift Confirmed
nodes.notes: Sets the rota cell to CONFIRMED.

nodes.name: Send Confirmation Reply
nodes.notes: SMTP send (Gmail app password). All ShiftHub mails go from the facility mailbox.
